name: prompt-1140
image_purpose: winter lifestyle lookbook and travel-fashion editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a sharp high-contrast winter lifestyle portrait inside a ski gondola, balancing the adult subject and bright snowy mountain view outside.
prompt.main_subject: Adult woman with pale natural skin, shoulder-length black wolf-cut hair with bangs, dramatic winged eyeliner, glossy lips, calm expression, and ski goggles resting on her head. She wears a shiny white cropped puffer jacket and black ski pants, seated inside the gondola and touching her hair behind one ear.
composition_elements: Candid seated portrait inside a cable-car gondola.
Large glass windows frame panoramic snowy Alpine mountains, ski tracks, pine trees, and blue sky.
Subject, gondola interior, and distant landscape remain sharp with deep depth of field.
Keep the winter clothing, goggles, hair gesture, and calm gaze consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright winter daylight through glass, crisp blue-and-white palette, defined cabin shadows, natural reflections, and cool travel atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Sony A7R V, 35mm lens, f/11 deep depth of field, 1/1000s, ISO 100, 2:3 portrait ratio, high-resolution photorealistic travel photography, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A candid raw lifestyle photograph shot on Sony A7R V with a 35mm lens at f/11, deep depth of field with everything in focus. An adult woman with pale natural skin and shoulder-length black hair with bangs and wolf-cut texture sits inside a ski gondola. She wears a shiny white cropped puffer jacket, black ski pants, and black ski goggles on her head. She touches her hair behind her ear and looks toward the camera with a calm expression. Dramatic e-girl makeup with winged eyeliner and glossy lips. Bright winter sunlight illuminates her face. Through the large glass window, a sharp panoramic view of snowy Alpine mountains, ski tracks, pine trees, and clear blue sky is visible with no bokeh. High contrast, winter travel aesthetic, 2:3 portrait, no text, no watermark.
